module rtlpp_08640 (
    tx,
    rx,
    alarm,
    clk
);

    output tx;
    input  rx;
    output alarm;
    input  clk;

    wire tx;
    wire rx;
    reg alarm;
    wire clk;

    wire [9:0] address;
    wire [17:0] instruction;
    wire [7:0] port_id;
    wire [7:0] out_port;
    reg [7:0] in_port;
    wire write_strobe;
    wire read_strobe;
    reg interrupt;
    wire interrupt_ack;

    wire [7:0] uart_status_port;

    reg [6:0] timer_count;
    reg timer_pulse;

    reg [9:0] baud_count;
    reg en_16_x_baud;
    wire write_to_uart;
    wire tx_full;
    wire tx_half_full;
    reg read_from_uart;
    wire [7:0] rx_data;
    wire rx_data_present;
    wire rx_full;
    wire rx_half_full;

    // KCPSM3 processor logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        // Processor logic here (Assume it's embedded in the same module)
        // Since we do not have the internal logic for kcpsm3, we need to assume it is implemented correctly.
    end

    // Uclock program ROM logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        // ROM logic here (Assume it's embedded in the same module)
        // Since we do not have the internal logic for uclock, we need to assume it is implemented correctly.
    end

    // Timer and interrupt logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (timer_count == 49) begin
            timer_count <= 1'b0;
            timer_pulse <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            timer_count <= timer_count + 1;
            timer_pulse <= 1'b0;
        end

        if (interrupt_ack == 1'b1) begin
            interrupt <= 1'b0;
        end else if (timer_pulse == 1'b1) begin 
            interrupt <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            interrupt <= interrupt;
        end
    end

    assign uart_status_port = {3'b000, rx_data_present, rx_full, rx_half_full, tx_full, tx_half_full};

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        case(port_id[0])
            1'b0: in_port <= uart_status_port;
            1'b1: in_port <= rx_data;
            default: in_port <= 8'bXXXXXXXX;
        endcase

        read_from_uart <= read_strobe & port_id[0];
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (write_strobe == 1'b1) begin
            if (port_id[0] == 1'b0) begin
                alarm <= out_port[0];
            end
        end
    end

    assign write_to_uart = write_strobe & port_id[0];

    // UART TX logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        // Transmit logic - assuming internal implementation of uart_tx
    end

    // UART RX logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        // Receive logic - assuming internal implementation of uart_rx
    end

    // Baud rate generator logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (baud_count == 324) begin
            baud_count <= 1'b0;
            en_16_x_baud <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            baud_count <= baud_count + 1;
            en_16_x_baud <= 1'b0;
        end
    end

endmodule
